dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three to five prominent, irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped perimeters exhibit a high-contrast transition from dark exterior fur to serrated, high-intensity white borders (approximately 5-15 pixels wide), encircling lower-intensity dark cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity white pixel clusters lacking internal tonal gradients, localized primarily in the interstitial spaces between the larger macro-annuli along the upper dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli form a large, obtuse scalene triangle; the two most proximal annuli are positioned in the upper-mid section, while the third is situated distally toward the posterior flank.

other_distinctive_markers: The texture exhibits a reticulated, web-like pattern where the high-contrast perimeters of adjacent macro-annuli converge and merge into continuous geometric chains.
